help.always_show_sidebar_on_desktop: Always keep the sidebar visible on desktop instead of auto-hiding it.
help.api_key: Set the API Key if you are using --api-key option for the server.
help.ask_for_title_confirmation: Ask for confirmation before automatically changing conversation title when editing the first message.
help.auto_show_sidebar_on_new_chat: Automatically show sidebar when starting a new chat. Disable to keep the sidebar hidden until you click on it.
help.backend_sampling: Enable backend-based samplers. When enabled, supported samplers run on the accelerator backend for faster sampling.
help.copy_text_attachments_as_plain_text: When copying a message with text attachments, combine them into a single plain text string instead of a special format that can be pasted back as attachments.
help.custom_json: Custom JSON parameters to send to the API. Must be valid JSON format.
help.disable_auto_scroll: Disable automatic scrolling while messages stream so you can control the viewport position manually.
help.dry_allowed_length: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the allowed length for DRY sampling.
help.dry_base: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling base value.
help.dry_multiplier: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets the DRY sampling multiplier.
help.dry_penalty_last_n: DRY sampling reduces repetition in generated text even across long contexts. This parameter sets DRY penalty for the last n tokens.
help.dynamic_temperature_exponent: Addon for the temperature sampler. Smoothes out the probability redistribution based on the most probable token.
help.dynamic_temperature_range: Addon for the temperature sampler. The added value to the range of dynamic temperature, which adjusts probabilities by entropy of tokens.
help.enable_continue_generation: Enable "Continue" button for assistant messages. Currently works only with non-reasoning models.
help.endpoint: Обирайте відповіді у відкритому форматі (рекомендовано) або використовуйте попередній формат відповідей у вигляді чату.
help.frequency_penalty: Limits tokens based on how often they appear in the output.
help.keep_stats_visible: Keep processing statistics visible after generation finishes.
help.max_tokens: The maximum number of token per output. Use -1 for infinite (no limit).
help.min_p: Limits tokens based on the minimum probability for a token to be considered, relative to the probability of the most likely token.
help.parse_pdf_as_image: Parse PDF as image instead of text. Automatically falls back to text processing for non-vision models.
help.paste_long_text_to_file_length: On pasting long text, it will be converted to a file. You can control the file length by setting the value of this parameter. Value 0 means disable.
help.presence_penalty: Limits tokens based on whether they appear in the output or not.
help.py_interpreter_enabled: Enable Python interpreter using Pyodide. Allows running Python code in markdown code blocks.
help.render_user_content_as_markdown: Render user messages using markdown formatting in the chat.
help.repeat_last_n: Last n tokens to consider for penalizing repetition
help.repeat_penalty: Controls the repetition of token sequences in the generated text
help.samplers: The order at which samplers are applied, in simplified way. Default is "top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;temperature": top_k->typ_p->top_p->min_p->temperature
help.show_message_stats: Display generation statistics (tokens/second, token count, duration) below each assistant message.
help.show_microphone_on_empty: Automatically show microphone button instead of send button when textarea is empty for models with audio modality support.
help.show_raw_llm_output: Show raw LLM output without backend parsing and frontend Markdown rendering to inspect streaming across different models.
help.show_system_message: Display the system message at the top of each conversation.
help.show_thought_in_progress: Expand thought process by default when generating messages.
help.show_tool_calls: Display tool call labels and payloads from Harmony-compatible delta.tool_calls data below assistant messages.
help.system_message: The starting message that defines how model should behave.
help.temperature: Controls the randomness of the generated text by affecting the probability distribution of the output tokens. Higher = more random, lower = more focused.
help.theme: Choose the color theme for the interface. You can choose between System (follows your device settings), Light, or Dark.
help.top_p: Limits tokens to those that together have a cumulative probability of at least p
help.typical_p: Sorts and limits tokens based on the difference between log-probability and entropy.
help.xtc_probability: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the chance of cutting tokens at all. 0 disables XTC.
help.xtc_threshold: XTC sampler cuts out top tokens; this parameter controls the token probability that is required to cut that token.
